LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_tv.lang_desc: the mounted tv. it is located above the rug and to the right of the sofa chair.
tv that is mounted on the wall. the tv is located above the display table and to the right of the picture.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_sofa chair.lang_desc: location of the sofa chair relative to other objects. the sofa chair is positioned next to the table.
blue velvet sofa chair in the room. look for the table on the left side, and the clock on the right side. the sofa chair is located between the table and the clock.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_couch.lang_desc: beige couch, which is located near a counter, a dining table, and a dining chair. the couch is positioned to the left of the counter and slightly above it. it is also situated to the right of the dining table and slightly below it. additionally, there is a pillow on the couch.

couch, which is a sectional couch, in relation to other objects in the room. the couch is located next to the table towards the left. on the left side of the couch, there is a picture hanging on the wall. towards the right side of the couch, there is a flowerpot on the floor. the couch is positioned below the bookshelf. find the couch using these spatial references.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_cabinet.lang_desc: built-in cabinet in the room. it is located near the rug in the lower part of the view. look for a painting on the left side of the cabinet. the pillow is also nearby, close to the right side of the cabinet.
the cabinet that is located to the right of the flowerpot. the cabinet is described as a white cabinet with a cork board on it.
laundry room cabinet that is located near the laundry machine and the basket.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_display cabinet.lang_desc: the display cabinet located below the kitchen lower cabinet and adjacent to the plate. it is on the right side of the flowerpot and just above the shelf. the display cabinet is made of glass.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_bathroom cabinet.lang_desc: bathroom cabinet located near the sink, toilet, and mirror. it has a dark blue color.
bathroom cabinet located next to the mirror and sink. it is on the same side as the toilet and the bathroom accessory. the bathroom cabinet is white in color.
bathroom cabinet located to the right of the mirror and below the towel. the bathroom cabinet is dark blue in color.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_sink.lang_desc: farmhouse sink located next to the lower kitchen cabinet and dishwasher.
farmhouse sink located in the kitchen lower cabinet.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_desk.lang_desc: wooden desk with a lamp on it. the desk is located near the rack and the chair, while being slightly to the left of the teapot.
desk located on the right side of the picture and towards the center of the frame. on the desk, you will find a chair and a lamp.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_chair.lang_desc: wingback chair located near a couch, a cabinet, a lamp, a picture, and a pillow.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_rack.lang_desc: rack, which is a closet organizer, located below the shelf.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_blanket.lang_desc: sheepskin blanket located on the left side of the chair, slightly below and to the left of the flower vase, and above the kitchen counter.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_kitchen lower cabi.lang_desc: the kitchen area and locate the lower cabinet. it is a cabinet with a lower shelf and drawers. look for it adjacent to the display cabinet and the sink.
kitchen lower cabinet located below the kitchen countertop items and above the kitchen cabinet. the lower cabinets of the kitchen are painted in a light blue color.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_oven and stove.lang_desc: oven and stove in the kitchen. the oven and stove are located next to the kitchen extractor and the kitchen countertop items.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_bed.lang_desc: king-sized bed that is located near a picture and a pillow in the frame.
king-sized bed located near the picture, pillow, and cabinet.
bed, which is a king size bed, located on the left side of the painting and slightly above the pillow.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_drawer.lang_desc: drawer, which is a dresser, in relation to other objects in the scene. the painting is located above the drawer, the lamp is to the left of the drawer, and the flowerpot is to the right of the drawer.
drawer made of reclaimed wood. the drawer is located beside the lamp and below the painting.
dresser that is near the mirror and the lamp.

LT9Jq6dN3Ea.basis.glb_bathtub.lang_desc: whirlpool tub located near a painting in the room.
